title: 第7章 小狗走失案
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

姜南溪解释道：“基本流程。不调查清楚，就凭你知道的那些案件信息，很难不把你列为嫌疑人。”

林知渔知道他们会调查，只是没想到会调查得这么详细，不过倒是可以问问她自己不知道的事情。

“那你们有没有调查到我亲生父母在哪里？”

钟嘉木很是诧异：“早在十年前他们就已经葬身火海了，你家里人没告诉你吗？”

林知渔有些愣神，“死了吗……”

她还想问问当年的他们为什么要干出调换孩子这种伤天害理的事情。

没想到就这么死了。

“我妈……林家人没有跟我说过这些。”林知渔又问，“那另外那个女孩这十年是怎么过的？”

“被亲戚家收养了呗。”

林知渔不再说话，她稍稍往后靠了靠，头偏了几分，望着窗外的风景，只觉得心里堵得慌。

欠下的这些，该怎么还得清啊。

林知渔在酒店门口下了车。

刚走进大门，她猛地停下了脚步。

酒店大厅旁边的沙发上，坐着一名穿着西装的男人，在他旁边还坐着一名女生，低着头，像鸵鸟似的，长直发遮住了她大半张脸，让人看不出她具体模样。

“小渔！”

林牧野一看到林知渔，立马拽着旁边女生的手腕，大步流星地走了过来。

林知渔下意识往后退了一步。

林牧野一把将那名女生拉扯到了林知渔跟前，语气冰冷，“道歉。”

林知渔登时睁大了眼眶，“哥，你干嘛！”

林牧野：“我知道肯定是她欺负你，所以你才离家出走的。”

“她没有欺负我，我们总共也就见过一面。”林知渔看了眼一直默不作声的女生，内心的亏欠不免又多了几分，“再说了，她才是你的亲生妹妹。”

听到这里，一直小心翼翼低着头的女生终于抬起了头，也露出了那张白皙漂亮的脸蛋。

林牧野嗤笑一声，“才不要一个这么胆小怯懦的人当我妹呢。”

他话里话外都带着一股不加掩饰的嫌弃，但在对林知渔说话的时候，语气又不禁软了几分，“小渔，你还是回来住，林氏集团养两个女儿还是养得起的。”

Jiang Nanxi explained: "The basic process. Without a clear investigation, it will be difficult not to label you as a suspect based on the case information you know."

Lin Zhiyu knew they would investigate, but she didn't expect the investigation to be so detailed. However, she could ask her about things she didn't know.

"Then have you investigated where my biological parents are?"

Zhong Jiamu was very surprised: "They were buried in the fire ten years ago. Didn't your family tell you?"

Lin Zhiyu was a little stunned, "Is he dead..."

She also wanted to ask them why they did such a sinful thing as exchanging children.

I didn't expect to die like this.

"My mother...the Lin family never told me this." Lin Zhiyu asked again, "How did the other girl spend these ten years?"

"She was adopted by a relative."

Lin Zhiyu stopped talking. She leaned back slightly, tilted her head a little, and looked at the scenery outside the window, feeling filled with panic.

How can I repay these debts?

Lin Zhiyu got off the car in front of the hotel.

As soon as she walked through the door, she stopped suddenly.

On the sofa next to the hotel lobby, a man in a suit sat, and next to him sat a girl, her head lowered, like an ostrich, with long straight hair covering most of her face, making it impossible to see her specific appearance.

"Xiaoyu!"

As soon as Lin Muye saw Lin Zhiyu, he immediately grabbed the wrist of the girl next to him and strode over.

Lin Zhiyu subconsciously took a step back.

Lin Muye pulled the girl to Lin Zhiyu and said in a cold tone, "Apologise."

Lin Zhiyu's eyes widened immediately, "Brother, what are you doing!"

Lin Muye: "I know she must have bullied you, so you ran away from home."

"She didn't bully me. We've only met once in total." Lin Zhiyu glanced at the girl who had been silent, feeling a little more indebted in his heart. "Besides, she is your biological sister."

After hearing this, the girl who had been keeping her head down carefully finally raised her head, revealing her fair and beautiful face.

Lin Muye sneered, "I don't want someone so timid and cowardly to be my sister."

There was an undisguised dislike in his words, but when he spoke to Lin Zhiyu, his tone couldn't help but soften a little, "Xiaoyu, you'd better come back and live there. The Lin Group can still afford to raise two daughters."
